About the guest

Kristen Twining is SVP Sales at Reco, which she joined in January 2026 after running Americas sales at FireMon, global sales at Illusive, ITDR sales at Proofpoint and a long run at HPE. She also hosts the podcast My Stilettos Hurt.

Notable quotes [...] Kristen Twining is the SVP of Sales at Reco, a company that secures AI and agents, and she's rebuilding its go-to-market to be AI forward. Her argument is that agentic GTM can't be a sales project. She explains why marketing and RevOps have to be in it from the start, what she told her reps when she pulled their tech stack, and the go-to-market engineer hire nobody knew existed a year ago.

In this episode [...] working with every day.
